page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside lines 2 to 4 of the text block. Running head at top, page number at top left. Catchword at the bottom right.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: commeandi vectandique facultatem incolis commodissimam praestant. Sed qui Hunesum augent, aut in aestuaria aut Dullartum effunduntur, claustris in exitu coercentur: caeteri libero lapsu Fivelae se miscent. Duo etiam ad urbem ipsam Groningam longis brachiis se porrigunt, Honaeus in occidente, Botteranus a borea.

Populi re-gionem co-lentesPopulorum minorum hanc regionem habitantium nomina, situs, ratio ita habent. Ad occidentem & meridiem Hunesi fluminis Langowoldij Oftergois finitimi, complexi vicos fanis insignes xiii: Fredowoldij in eadem plaga Sylvestribus ac Drentiae propinqui, vicis x Lagowol-dij.comprehensi,tenui in solo utrique: Hummertzij in latere aestuarij Lavicani ad effluxum fluminis jam dicti, eluvionibus Fredewol-dij.ad tres tantum vicos redacti, sed agri felicis, ubi rivus ex Drentia descendens, & Transhunesanam omnem regionem per-errans canali novo ad castellum militare Hummert-zij.compressus in idem aestuarium exit, & alluvio nunc reddit, quod diluvia quondam & tempestatum vis abstulerunt:

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The left-margin notes are placed beside the lines where they stand. The catchword "Medachij" is set in italic in the original. Printed text ends at "abstulerunt:" with a signature-like word at the right foot, read as catchword.
